subject.title: [Feature]: Goal continuance — per-turn goal context + QA continuance scenarios

question: Should OpenClaw inject an active session goal into every later inbound turn, and should this stay as a narrow per-turn context/QA change rather than broader durable goal-planning state?
rationale: This changes model-visible prompt behavior for every active-goal session and the issue already carries a protected maintainer label, so automation should not choose the permanent prompt contract on its own.

options.title: Approve narrow goal context
options.body: Add a compact active-goal line to the volatile per-turn context path plus focused QA for start, compaction, and followthrough, with no config or plan-state expansion.

options.title: Defer to broader planning design
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers decide whether goal continuance should be solved by a larger goal-planning or task-flow contract.

options.title: Keep explicit get_goal only
options.body: Leave goals as pull-based model tools plus `/goal` controls and reject automatic per-turn injection for now.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow goal context
recommendation.body: Add a compact active-goal line to the volatile per-turn context path plus focused QA for start, compaction, and followthrough, with no config or plan-state expansion.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced core session goals, authored this maintainer-labeled request, and owns the most relevant current code history.
